criterion_scope: D12 criteria do not grade exact-build runtime conformance. Installed cases grade evidence bytes only. No case executed.

cases.setup_action: Parse E3 four rack classes, ZoneRange and MacroSnapshot.
cases.expected_comparator: Exactly sixteen macro slots and snapshot values/presence flags; four zone bounds.

cases.setup_action: Reparse E4 Suite demo and count rack elements.
cases.expected_comparator: Audio 23, MIDI 1, Instrument 8, Drum 1; Creator 12.4d1.

cases.setup_action: Decode E5 slicing ADG.
cases.expected_comparator: Five MacroSnapshot entries; record their stored value/presence fields without recall inference.

cases.setup_action: Put a MIDI effect in a MIDI Effect Rack on a MIDI track.
cases.expected_comparator: Valid documented signal configuration.

cases.setup_action: Drag an instrument into an audio-only rack, then load equivalent malformed XML.
cases.open_result: U: refusal vs relocation/replacement and UI/load differences.

cases.setup_action: Instrument chain: MIDI effect, instrument, audio effect.
cases.expected_comparator: MIDI processing precedes synthesis; audio effect follows it.

cases.setup_action: Rack with two distinct active chains receiving a qualifying note.
cases.expected_comparator: Both chains receive the note; outputs feed the enclosing downstream chain.

cases.setup_action: Group a device twice, then select outer title.
cases.expected_comparator: Two rack levels; outer selection addresses enclosing rack.

cases.setup_action: Group two serial effects; Ungroup the resulting one-chain rack.
cases.expected_comparator: Group creates an enclosing rack; Ungroup dismantles it.

cases.setup_action: Ungroup a rack with parallel outputs, mappings and returns.
cases.open_result: U: flattening, routing and mapping disposition.

cases.setup_action: Select chain A then B; multiselect both.
cases.expected_comparator: Device View follows selected chain; multiselection indicates two.

cases.setup_action: Enable Auto Select; send note assigned only to drum chain B.
cases.expected_comparator: B selected; selection expiry/timing ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Key zone 60–72, velocity 50–100, selector 3. Send (64,80) at 3, then (59,80), (64,40), and (64,80) at 2.
cases.expected_comparator: First admitted; each of three failing inputs excluded.

cases.setup_action: Send notes 60 and 72 at exact resized key edges; vary selector fractionally.
cases.open_result: U: precise inclusive edges and fractional selector rounding.

cases.setup_action: Full-range velocity zone, no fades; send Note On velocities 1 and 127.
cases.expected_comparator: Both are in the documented zone range. Velocity zero ungraded.

cases.setup_action: Inspect zone editors for Audio Effect Rack and Drum Rack.
cases.expected_comparator: Audio rack lacks key/velocity editors; Drum Rack lacks zone editors.

cases.setup_action: Assign two chain zones to single values 0 and 127; select each value.
cases.expected_comparator: Only its matching single-value chain is addressed.

cases.setup_action: Excluded selector zone, default controller filtering; send a CC and a note.
cases.expected_comparator: CC passes selector filter; note does not.

cases.setup_action: Repeat RCK-018 with Chain Selector Filters MIDI Ctrl enabled.
cases.expected_comparator: Both excluded by selector filter.

cases.setup_action: Put a note inside a nonzero key fade, away from endpoints, velocity 100.
cases.expected_comparator: Incoming note velocity attenuated; factor/rounding U.

cases.setup_action: Existing Instrument/Audio Effect Rack tail; leave selector zone through ending fade.
cases.expected_comparator: Chain output attenuated to zero outside zone; onset/time samples U.

cases.setup_action: Same tail setup with no selector fade.
cases.expected_comparator: Leaving zone alone does not attenuate existing tail.

cases.setup_action: Create a factory rack with no custom rack default or loaded preset; change shown count to sixteen, save/reopen.
cases.expected_comparator: Initially eight shown; sixteen available; chosen visibility retained.

cases.setup_action: Map contained control to macro; set Min greater than Max; invoke Invert Range.
cases.expected_comparator: Mapping Browser lists assignment and inverted range, then reversed bounds. Interpolation U.

cases.setup_action: Map a contained control, then inspect direct edit and clip modulation capability.
cases.expected_comparator: Direct control disabled; modulation capability remains. Resulting signal U.

cases.setup_action: With no custom macro name, map two targets with the same unit type/range to macro 3; reset mappings, then map two targets with different units.
cases.expected_comparator: Both phases show generic Macro 3 name. Same-unit/range phase retains common units/range; different-unit phase shows 0–127 units.

cases.setup_action: Mapped macro A excluded from randomization, B included; press Rand.
cases.expected_comparator: A unchanged; no demand that B differ on every draw. Distribution U.

cases.setup_action: Load an unmodified factory Instrument Rack preset with a Volume-assigned macro, with no user exclusion override.
cases.expected_comparator: That macro excluded by default; newly created mappings outside claim.

cases.setup_action: Set mapped macros A=20,B=90; New; change A=70,B=10; launch saved variation.
cases.expected_comparator: A=20,B=90 restored in documented value domain. Exact timing U.

cases.setup_action: RCK-029 with A excluded from variations while currently A=70.
cases.expected_comparator: A remains 70; B recalls 90. Disable exclusion and relaunch: A recalls 20.

cases.setup_action: Store two variations; rename, duplicate, overwrite selected one, delete duplicate.
cases.expected_comparator: Named entries and count reflect operations; overwritten variation recalls newly stored state.

cases.setup_action: Receive 36, Play 60; send 36 and 37 separately.
cases.expected_comparator: 36 triggers chain with output note 60; 37 does not trigger it.

cases.setup_action: Receive All Notes; send 36 then 64.
cases.expected_comparator: Play/Choke disabled; received pitches pass unchanged to devices.

cases.setup_action: Two sustained drum chains in same choke group; trigger A then B.
cases.expected_comparator: B silences A; release curve/time and self-choke U.

cases.setup_action: Drum Rack with no returns; add one return.
cases.expected_comparator: No send controls initially; sends become available with return.

cases.setup_action: Create six audio-effect drum returns.
cases.expected_comparator: Six is documented supported limit; attempted seventh handled in RCK-061.

cases.setup_action: Drum send into return; choose rack output, then existing Set return.
cases.expected_comparator: Return output destination follows chooser; exact audio/gain/latency U.

cases.setup_action: Factory sample-dropping defaults; drop sample A on empty pad 36, then audio effect.
cases.expected_comparator: Chain with Simpler A; effect follows it.

cases.setup_action: Chain MIDI effect → Simpler A → audio effect; drop sample B on same pad.
cases.expected_comparator: Sample/instrument replaced; both surrounding effects retained.

cases.setup_action: Drop samples A/B on empty pad 36 normally.
cases.expected_comparator: Two Simplers/chains assigned upward chromatically from 36; multiselection order U.

cases.setup_action: Swap populated pads 36/38 by normal drag; play unchanged clip notes.
cases.expected_comparator: Note assignments swapped; clip notes now trigger swapped sounds.

cases.setup_action: Cmd-drag two samples on macOS / Alt-drag on Windows onto pad 36.
cases.expected_comparator: Both samples layered in nested Instrument Rack; platform parity U.

cases.setup_action: Two chains receive 36; inspect pad, then rename/hot-swap and mute.
cases.expected_comparator: Multi label; rename/hot-swap unavailable; mute addresses both chains.

cases.setup_action: Unfold two-chain Instrument Rack in Session; change pan in either view.
cases.expected_comparator: Chain has no clip slots; corresponding pan display mirrors change.

cases.setup_action: Two chains equal starting volume; multiselect in Session, adjust one; repeat via chain list.
cases.expected_comparator: Session adjustment affects both; list adjustment lacks this multi-chain behavior. Unequal starts U.

cases.setup_action: Drum clip notes 36/38; extract only chain receiving 38 to new track from mixer; repeat from chain list on reset Set.
cases.expected_comparator: Mixer route transfers chain devices and its MIDI notes; list route devices only. Shared-note/nested ownership U.

cases.setup_action: Drag a Drum Rack return into mixer drop area.
cases.expected_comparator: New Set return track; exact send reassignment U.

cases.setup_action: Select empty MIDI track; Enter a browser instrument; separately drop sample in its empty Device View.
cases.expected_comparator: Instrument loads; sample scenario creates Simpler.

cases.setup_action: Copy effect X; select effect B in A→B chain and paste, then select empty chain end and paste.
cases.expected_comparator: First copy immediately before B; second at end.

cases.setup_action: Audible processing effect active; turn activator off.
cases.expected_comparator: Effect processing bypassed qualitatively; delay/tails/state/CPU counts U.

cases.setup_action: Enter Hot-Swap; load a compatible preset; press Esc.
cases.expected_comparator: Hot-Swap exits; rollback to pre-load preset is not an expected result.

cases.setup_action: Save Preset, give prospective name; press Esc instead of Enter.
cases.expected_comparator: Save process cancelled; exact files/temp cleanup and pre-existing overwrite atomicity U.

cases.setup_action: In copied XML set zone Min=100, Max=20; fade outside zone; invalid receiving/choke value.
Duplicate/missing snapshot values, absent presence flags; load a copy.
cases.open_result: U: rack-specific reader response and defaults.

cases.setup_action: Begin pad replacement, chain extraction or mapping; cancel before completion.
cases.open_result: U: rollback, selection, dirty-state, source MIDI and undo outcome.

cases.setup_action: Hold a note/sustain; delete rack/chain, remove mapping, change selector or close Set.
cases.open_result: U: note-off, tail, cleanup and scheduler behavior.

cases.setup_action: Recall variation and automate selector at transport boundary with delayed contained device.
cases.open_result: U: event order, compensation, smoothing and sample timing.

cases.setup_action: Edit zones/maps/exclusions/routing, undo/redo, save/reopen and migrate.
cases.open_result: U: exact preserved state and transaction grouping, apart from RCK-023 visibility.

cases.setup_action: Drop three samples at pad 127, including missing second sample.
cases.open_result: U: overflow handling, partial load and effects retention.

cases.setup_action: Disable a sounding instrument or entire mixed rack.
cases.open_result: U: MIDI-to-audio bypass, retained state/tails and CPU/latency effects.

cases.setup_action: Attempt seventh Drum Rack return through UI and copied document.
cases.open_result: U: rejection/repair and whether UI vs load differs.
